meaning: 快时尚服装，廉价潮流衣物
usageNote: 名词短语！说那些H&M、ZARA这类便宜又赶潮流的衣服，带点批判语气，环保党超爱用这词！

examples.en: She tries to avoid buying fast-fashion clothes because of the environmental impact.
examples.zh: 她尽量避免购买快时尚服装，因为这对环境有影响。

examples.en: Fast-fashion clothes may look trendy, but they often fall apart after a few washes.
examples.zh: 快时尚服装看起来很时髦，但往往洗几次就坏了。
